name: watchWrites
what: a watch read each document when delivered, so under fast writes it saw a later state twice and missed one, and a deploy or build could go unfollowed

name: useLogSocket
what: a followed log's socket was made without connecting, and its reconnect listener never fired, so app and build logs sat silent

name: requireAuth
what: the pool's trial, move and monitoring paths stayed open without sign-in after the pool went, and three prefixes were open on roles that serve nothing there

name: followedAction
what: a resize or settings sync followed from its record alone was settled as a plain deploy

name: stopIfRunning
what: stopping a workflow waits 60 seconds and then terminates it, a deadline that calls work stopped by giving up (found by research, not yet fixed)
